entries.def:
βιόω, -ῶ 
(βίος), [in LXX: Pro.7.2; 9.6 (חיה), Job.29.18, Wis.4.4 א 1, 12:23, Sir.40.28, 4Ma.5.22; 17.18 * ;] 
to spend life, to live: τ. χρόνον βιῶσαι (cl., more frequently 2 aor., -ναι), 1Pe.4.2 (cf. Jb, l.with).† 
SYN.: ζάω (which see). (AS)

βίωσις, -εως, ἡ 
(βιόω), [in LXX: Si prol. 12 * ;] 
manner of life: Act.26.4.†
(AS)

βιωτικός, -ή, -όν 
(βιός), 
pertaining to life, hence, worldly (Field, Notes, 171): Luk.21.34, 1Co.6.3, 4.†
(AS)

βλάπτω, 
[in LXX: Pro.25.20, Tob.12.2, Wis.10.8; 18.2, 2Ma.12.22, 4Ma.9.7 * ;] 
to hurt, injure: with accusative, Mrk.16:[18], Luk.4.35.†
(AS)

βλαστάνω, 
[in LXX for צמח, etc. ;] 
__1. to sprout: Mat.13.26, Mrk.4.27, Heb.9.4. 
__2. In late Gk., causal, to make to grow, produce: with accusative, Jas.5.18.
† (AS)

Βλάστος, -ου, ὁ, 
Blastus, chamberlain of Agrippa: Act.12.20.†
(AS)

βλασφημέω, -ῶ 
(βλάσφημος), [in LXX: 2Ki.19.4 (יכח hi.) ib. 6, 22 (גּדף pi.), Isa.52.5 (נאץ hith.), Dan LXX 3:29 (96) (אמר שׁלח), Tob.1.18, Da TH Bel 9, 2Ma.2 * ;] 
__1. to speak lightly or profanely of sacred things (in cl., opp. of εὐφημέω), esp. to speak impiously of God, to blaspheme, speak blasphemously: absol., Mat.9.3; 26.65, Mrk.2.7, Jhn.10.36, Act.26.11, 1Ti.1.20, 2Pe.2.12; τ. θεόν, Act.19.37, Rev.16.11,…

βλασφημία, -ας, ἡ 
(βλάσφημος), [in LXX: Ezk.35.12 (נֶאָצָה), Dan.3.29 (96) (שׁלה), Tob.1.18, 1Ma.2.6, 2Ma.8.4; 10.35; 15.24 * ;] 
__(a) railing slander: Mat.12.31; 15.19, Mrk.3.28; 7.22, Eph.4.31, Col.3.8, 1Ti.6.4, Jude.9, Rev.2.9 
__(b) spec., impious speech against God, blasphemy: Mat.26.65, Mrk.14.64, Luk.5.21, Jhn.10.33, Rev.13.5; ὄνομα βλασφημίας, Rev.13.1; 17.3; with genitive obj. Mat.12.31 πρὸς τ. θεόν,…

βλάσφημος, -ον 
(βλασ-, of uncertain deriv., see Thayer, Boisacq; + φήμη, speech), [in LXX: Isa.66.3 (מְבָרֵךְ אָוֶן), Wis.1.6, Sir.3.16, 2Ma.9.28; 10.4, 36 * ;] 
__(a) evil-speaking, slanderous, blasphemous: Act.6.11, 2Ti.3.2, 2Pe.2.11 (cf. Jude.9); 
__(b) as subst. a blasphemer: 1Ti.1.13 (Cremer, 570).
† (AS)
